units.source_text: 你家那个守关人，真教我又羡又妒呢！”

en.t: That gatekeeper of yours truly makes me both envious and jealous!"

units.source_text: 又对右卫门佐说：“我和她隔绝多年，现在好像是初初相识。

en.t: Then he said to Uemon no Suke, "She and I have been separated for many years, and now it feels as if we are meeting for the very first time.

units.source_text: 但因时刻不忘，我惯把昔日的旧情看作今日的新欢。

en.t: But because I have never stopped thinking of her, I am used to treating the old affection of the past as the new delight of today.

units.source_text: 说到风情，只怕她又将生气了？”

en.t: If I speak of romance, I fear she will only grow angry again."
After saying this, he handed over the letter.

units.source_text: 右卫门佐深感荣幸，连忙将去送与姐姐，

en.t: Uemon no Suke felt deeply honored and hurried off to deliver it to his sister,

units.source_text: 又对她说：“你还是应该写回信的。

en.t: and said to her, "You really ought to write a reply.

units.source_text: 我原以为公子对你总该疏远了些，但他的心全同昔年一样亲切，盛情真可感谢。

en.t: I had thought the gentleman must surely have grown somewhat distant from you, but his heart is just as warm as it was in the old days, and his deep feeling is truly something to be grateful for.

units.source_text: 充当这等送信的使者，也自觉无聊乏味，多此一举。

en.t: Serving as the messenger for a letter like this feels dull and tedious even to me, as if it were an unnecessary errand.

units.source_text: 但感于公子的亲切，难以断然拒绝。

en.t: But moved by the gentleman's kindness, I found it hard to refuse him outright.

units.source_text: 何况你是女人，情动于中而屈节作复，此罪亦可原宥。”

en.t: Besides, you are a woman, and if your feelings are stirred and you bend enough to answer him, even that fault may be forgiven."

units.source_text: 空蝉现在比前更加怕羞了，总觉得难以为情。

en.t: Utsusemi had become even more shy than before, and always felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 但念公子赐信，实甚难得。

en.t: But when she thought of the gentleman's letter, she knew it was truly a rare favor.

units.source_text: 想是不胜感动之极，终于援笔作复：

en.t: Perhaps she was finally overcome with emotion, for at last she took up her brush and wrote a reply:
